# RWO-001 post-hoc: precomputed experimental protocol export regeneration
# Context: the app-server-protocol crate vendors generated artifacts. Adding
# protocol methods changes what ts-rs/schemars generate, so the experimental
# precomputed export (schema/precomputed/app-server-exports-experimental.json.zst)
# must contain the new types or `cargo test -p codex-app-server-protocol`'s
# experimental_precomputed_exports_match_generated test fails. cargo is absent
# here, so the export was regenerated by replicating the generator behavior.

## Method
1. A python generator (kept with this sandbox workspace at
   /home/z/rwo001-cal/regenerate_experimental_zst.py) parses the ACTUAL Rust
   sources (v2/workflow.rs type definitions; common.rs method entries) —
   the artifacts are derived from the same source the Rust derives read,
   not transcribed by hand.
2. ts-rs 11 output was replicated to the byte following the formats observed
   in the pre-existing tree entries (header/blank-line/imports conventions,
   quoted camelCase enum literals, the doc-comment/field-joining layout of
   struct bodies, Record<string, never> for empty structs, `?: T | null` for
   optional-nullable params fields, `?: Array<T>` for serde-defaulted vecs).
3. schemars 0.8.22 output was replicated as VALUE-equal JSON (the tests
   compare parsed JSON values; key order is irrelevant, array order is not):
   nested definitions without titles, root schemas with titles, enum arrays
   in declaration order, required arrays alphabetical, Option<T> as
   ["T","null"] or anyOf[$ref,null], u64 with format/minimum, Vec with
   items/type, serde-defaulted vecs with "default": [].
4. The bundle (codex_app_server_protocol.schemas.json) and the flat v2 bundle
   were updated in place: 50 new definitions under definitions.v2 (refs
   namespaced to #/definitions/v2/), and 13 new ClientRequest oneOf arms with
   the annotate titles ("Workflow/teach/startRequest" and
   "Workflow/teach/startRequestMethod") and variant-doc descriptions, inserted
   after the userVerification/verify arm and before thread/start (macro order).
5. The zst was repacked: PrecomputedExports {typescript, json_schema,
   internal_json_schema} serialized with sorted keys and zstd level 19
   (the tests compare DECOMPRESSED content, so the compressor is not
   load-bearing).

## Verification actually performed (python, real runs)
$ python3 /home/z/rwo001-cal/regenerate_experimental_zst.py
    verification: all structural invariants hold
    wrote app-server-protocol/schema/precomputed/app-server-exports-experimental.json.zst:
        897 TS files, 451 JSON files, 5399273->5399527 bytes payload

Diff audit against the pre-regeneration zst (backup kept at
/home/z/rwo001-cal/app-server-exports-experimental.json.zst.orig):
  typescript:  added = exactly 50 v2/Workflow*.ts files; removed = 0
               changed pre-existing = ClientRequest.ts, v2/index.ts (intended)
  json_schema: added = exactly 25 v2/Workflow*.json files (13 params +
               12 responses); removed = 0
               changed pre-existing = ClientRequest.json,
               codex_app_server_protocol.schemas.json,
               codex_app_server_protocol.v2.schemas.json (intended)
  internal_json_schema: untouched
  Every pre-existing entry NOT in the intended-change set is byte-identical.

Changed-file diff audits:
  ClientRequest.ts: removing the 13 new union arms and 13 new imports from
    the regenerated file reproduces the original byte-for-byte.
  ClientRequest.json: pre-existing definitions and oneOf arms are identical;
    +17 workflow definitions (13 params + their 4 referenced dependency types
    WorkflowTeachMode, WorkflowTeachEvidenceInput, WorkflowDemonstrationKind,
    WorkflowApprovalDecision) and +13 arms in macro order.
  bundle + flat bundle: +50 definitions.v2 entries, +13 arms; every
    pre-existing definition and arm byte-identical.

Shape parity against the pre-existing tree (real comparisons):
  - my ClientRequest arm keys == the thread/start arm keys
    (description, properties, required, title, type) with the same
    $ref/discriminator shapes;
  - my enum definition shape == UserVerificationUnavailableReason's
    ({"description"?, "enum": [...], "type": "string"}, no title);
  - my struct field schemas match the FeedbackUploadParams/SkillsListParams/
    AppsListResponse conventions for Option/Vec/serde-default fields.

Honest limitation: the artifacts were NOT produced by running ts-rs/schemars
(cargo absent). The Tech Lead should re-run `just write-app-server-schema` and
diff against this zst; any difference would be caught by the same
experimental_precomputed_exports_match_generated test this work preserves.
